steps.title: Stripe billing behind env
steps.goal: The web app can bill a church through Stripe without any key being present at build time: `apps/web/src/lib/stripe/{client,sync}.ts` wrap the `stripe` 22.6.1 SDK and the mirror into `billing_customers` / `billing_subscriptions` / `stripe_events`; `POST /api/billing/checkout` and `POST /api/billing/portal` (super admin only) create the Stripe Customer up front and open Checkout for the single US$50/month recurring Price `STRIPE_PRICE_ID`; `POST /api/stripe/webhook` verifies the raw body, returns 503 when `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is missing, is idempotent via `stripe_events`, ignores out-of-order events by `event_created`, re-reads the subscription from Stripe and returns 500 on handler errors so Stripe retries. The Billing tab of `/admin/churches/[orgId]` shows a 'Stripe is not configured' banner and disabled buttons while the three `STRIPE_*` env vars are absent (the state at Checkpoint A), and live buttons plus the subscription badge once the founder fills them in step 3.9. Vitest covers the webhook (503, bad signature, idempotency, out-of-order, handler error → 500, status mapping).
steps.prompt:
You are working in the ChurchAppCLD repository. CLAUDE.md loads `new_session_instructions.md` and `HANDOFF.md` automatically — follow the session-start checklist (new-session.sh, prompt_history.txt). Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session. This is step 2.3 "Stripe billing behind env" of `docs/TODO.md`; read that step's 'Done when' list first. Read `docs/PLAN.md` §1 item 7, §7 (Stripe row and env var list), §8 (`api/` routes) and §13 founder answer 7, and `docs/DESIGN.md` §1 item 7, §4 (the `organizations`, `billing_customers`, `billing_subscriptions`, `stripe_events` tables and the `mirror_subscription_status` trigger), §6 (billing rows of the policy table), §8 (Stripe Checkout / Portal and Stripe webhook rows) and §9 (super admin Billing tab) before writing code. Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
When you finish, the super admin's Billing tab on `/admin/churches/[orgId]` is wired to Stripe *behind environment variables*: with `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and `STRIPE_PRICE_ID` unset (the situation at Checkpoint A, step 2.5) the tab shows a clear "Stripe is not configured" banner, the Checkout and Portal buttons are disabled, and nothing crashes; with the three variables set (the founder does that in step 3.9) the buttons open Stripe Checkout / the Stripe customer portal, and the webhook keeps `billing_customers`, `billing_subscriptions` and `stripe_events` in sync so the existing DB trigger `app.mirror_subscription_status` moves `organizations.status`. Founder decision 7 applies verbatim: "Billing: flat $50 / month / church; one Stripe recurring Price → `STRIPE_PRICE_ID`; trial 30 days (`trial_ends_at`); only `suspended` blocks writes; `past_due` = banner only. Usage-based billing may come later (keep `billing_mode` enum extensible)." The webhook's unit tests pass without network access.

## Inputs / prior state
- Step 2.1 produced `apps/web` (Next 16.3, `proxy.ts` whose matcher already excludes `/api/stripe/webhook` — verify, do not weaken it), `src/lib/supabase/{server,client,service}.ts` (`service.ts` is server-only and builds the service-role client from `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY ?? SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`), `src/lib/auth/require-super.ts` (`requireSuperAdmin()` built on `my_context()`), shadcn components under `src/components/ui/*`, `vitest.config.ts`, `.env.example`.
- Step 2.2 produced `app/(super)/admin/*` including `app/(super)/admin/churches/[orgId]/page.tsx` with the Billing tab component `src/features/orgs/BillingPanel.tsx` (billing_mode select, trial date, status incl. suspend/cancel; "Stripe buttons disabled until 2.3"). Read it before changing it and keep its Server Actions for `billing_mode`, `trial_ends_at` and status.
- Steps 1.2–1.5 fixed the schema in `supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql`. Read the real column lists there — do not assume: `organizations (id, slug, name, status org_status, billing_mode billing_mode default 'manual', trial_ends_at, contact_email, …)`, `billing_customers` (at least `org_id` and `stripe_customer_id`; use whatever 1.2 created), `billing_subscriptions (stripe_subscription_id text primary key, org_id, status subscription_status default 'unknown', status_raw text not null, event_created bigint not null default 0, price_id, quantity, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, trial_end, canceled_at, raw jsonb, updated_at)`, `stripe_events (id text primary key, type, event_created bigint, received_at, processed_at, error)`. The enum `subscription_status` holds Stripe's set plus `none` and `unknown` (values fixed in 1.2 — read them). RLS (DESIGN §6): `billing_customers` / `billing_subscriptions` are readable by `org.settings` holders and super admins, insertable/updatable by `service` only; `stripe_events` readable by super admins, written by `service` only. The trigger `app.mirror_subscription_status` maps subscription status → `organizations.status` only when `billing_mode = 'stripe'`; the webhook must never write `organizations.status` itself.
- `@church/db` (step 1.7) exports typed `database.types.ts`, `client.ts`, `queries/orgs.ts`; `@church/domain` exports Zod 4.5 schemas and `errors.ts`. `docs/ENV.md` (1.1) already has rows for `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `STRIPE_PRICE_ID` — you will refine them.
- No Stripe account keys exist yet and you must not ask for any. Everything here is verified with unit tests and a local dev server without keys.

## Build
1. **Dependency.** Add `stripe` `22.6.1` (exact) to `apps/web/package.json` dependencies (PLAN §3). Do not add it to the pnpm catalog (web-only). Run `pnpm install`; the lockfile changes are part of this commit.
2. **`apps/web/src/lib/stripe/client.ts`** (server-only; start with `import 'server-only'`).
   - `export function stripeConfig()` → `{ secretKey, webhookSecret, priceId, configured: boolean, missing: string[] }` read from `process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `STRIPE_PRICE_ID`; `configured` is true only when all three are non-empty. Never log or return the values to a client component — only booleans and the `missing` names.
   - `export function getStripe(): Stripe | null` — `null` when `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` is absent; otherwise a memoised `new Stripe(secretKey, { typescript: true, appInfo: { name: 'Anacast' } })`. Do not pin `apiVersion`; the SDK's bundled version is the one its types describe.
   - `export function appUrl()` → `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` without a trailing slash; throw a clear error if it is unset (the checkout/portal routes need absolute URLs).
3. **`apps/web/src/lib/stripe/sync.ts`** (server-only; uses the service client from `src/lib/supabase/service.ts` because the billing tables are `service` insert/update).
   - `export function mapStripeStatus(raw: string): Database['public']['Enums']['subscription_status']` — pure; returns the matching enum value for Stripe's `active | trialing | past_due | unpaid | canceled | incomplete | incomplete_expired | paused` and `unknown` for anything else. The raw string is always stored in `status_raw` (DESIGN §13: "unknown Stripe statuses never fail the insert but the UI keeps a typed badge").
   - `export function shouldApply(storedEventCreated: number, incomingEventCreated: number): boolean` — pure; `incoming >= stored`.
   - `export function subscriptionSnapshot(sub: Stripe.Subscription, eventCreated: number)` — pure; builds the `billing_subscriptions` row: `stripe_subscription_id = sub.id`, `status = mapStripeStatus(sub.status)`, `status_raw = sub.status`, `event_created`, `price_id = sub.items.data[0]?.price.id ?? null`, `quantity`, `current_period_start/end` — read them from `sub.items.data[0]` first (recent Stripe API versions moved the period fields onto subscription items) and fall back to the top-level fields when they exist on the typed object; `cancel_at_period_end`, `trial_end`, `canceled_at` (Unix seconds → ISO strings), `raw = sub` as JSON.
   - `export async function ensureCustomer(orgId: string, deps)` — looks up `billing_customers` by `org_id`; when missing, loads the org (`name`, `contact_email`) with the service client, calls `stripe.customers.create({ name, email: contact_email ?? undefined, metadata: { org_id: orgId } }, { idempotencyKey: `customer:${orgId}` })` (DESIGN §8: "creates the Stripe Customer first … idempotency key = org id; `metadata.org_id`"), inserts the row, returns `stripe_customer_id`.
   - `export async function resolveOrgId(deps, { customerId, metadataOrgId })` — first `billing_customers.stripe_customer_id = customerId`, then `metadataOrgId` (from `subscription.metadata.org_id`, `checkout.session.metadata.org_id` or `client_reference_id`); when only metadata resolves it, upsert the `billing_customers` row so future events resolve by customer. Returns `null` when neither resolves.
   - `export async function syncSubscription(deps, subscriptionId: string, eventCreated: number)` — `stripe.subscriptions.retrieve(subscriptionId)` (the subscription fetched from Stripe is authoritative, never the event payload); resolve the org; read the stored `event_created` for that `stripe_subscription_id`; if `!shouldApply(stored, eventCreated)` return `{ applied: false, reason: 'stale' }`; otherwise upsert the snapshot with `org_id` and return `{ applied: true }`. The DB trigger takes care of `organizations.status`.
   - `deps` is an object `{ stripe: Stripe, db: SupabaseClient<Database> }` passed explicitly so tests can inject fakes; export `defaultDeps()` that builds it from `getStripe()` and the service client and throws `StripeNotConfiguredError` when `getStripe()` is null.
4. **`apps/web/src/lib/stripe/webhook.ts`** (name chosen here because DESIGN §2 lists only `client.ts`/`sync.ts`; keep it) — `export async function handleStripeWebhook(input: { rawBody: string; signature: string | null }, deps): Promise<{ status: number; body: object }>`, fully testable without `Request`:
   - If `deps.webhookSecret` is empty → `{ status: 503, body: { error: 'webhook_not_configured' } }` (DESIGN §8: "503 if secret missing" — never skip verification).
   - If `signature` is null or `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(rawBody, signature, secret)` throws → 400 `invalid_signature`.
   - Insert `stripe_events { id: event.id, type: event.type, event_created: event.created, received_at: now }`. On a primary-key conflict read the existing row: `processed_at not null` → return 200 `{ received: true, duplicate: true }` without reprocessing; `processed_at null` → continue (reprocess a previously failed delivery).
   - Dispatch on `event.type`: `checkout.session.completed` → subscription id from `session.subscription` (string or object); `customer.subscription.created`, `customer.subscription.updated`, `customer.subscription.deleted` → `event.data.object.id`; `invoice.payment_succeeded`, `invoice.payment_failed` → subscription id from `invoice.parent?.subscription_details?.subscription` with a fallback to the legacy `invoice.subscription` field (both shapes exist across Stripe API versions; write a small `subscriptionIdFromInvoice()` helper and test it). Every other type is recorded and acknowledged with 200 `{ received: true, ignored: true }`.
   - For handled types call `syncSubscription(deps, subscriptionId, event.created)`. A stale result is not an error: set `processed_at`, `error = 'stale_event_ignored'`, return 200.
   - If the org cannot be resolved (no `billing_customers` row and no `org_id` metadata): set `processed_at`, `error = 'org_not_found'`, return 200 — retrying cannot fix it, and a permanent 500 would make Stripe disable the endpoint. Record this deviation from the plan's "500 on error" rule in HANDOFF.md.
   - Any other thrown error: update the `stripe_events` row with `error = message` (leave `processed_at` null) and return 500 `{ error: 'handler_error' }` so Stripe retries (PLAN §1 item 7).
   - On success set `processed_at = now()`, `error = null`, return 200 `{ received: true }`.
5. **`apps/web/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts`** — `export const runtime = 'nodejs'`, `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`; `POST`: `const rawBody = await req.text()` (never `req.json()` — the signature covers the exact bytes), `signature = req.headers.get('stripe-signature')`, `const { status, body } = await handleStripeWebhook({ rawBody, signature }, defaultWebhookDeps())`, `return NextResponse.json(body, { status })`. `defaultWebhookDeps()` must not throw when Stripe is unconfigured — the handler returns 503 itself. Export no other method (GET → 405 by default).
6. **`apps/web/app/api/billing/checkout/route.ts`** — `runtime = 'nodejs'`, `POST` only:
   1. Same-origin check: the `origin` header (or `referer`) must match `appUrl()`; otherwise 403.
   2. Authorisation with the user-scoped server client: reuse `requireSuperAdmin()`; if it redirects on failure, add a non-redirecting sibling `getSuperAdminContext()` in `src/lib/auth/require-super.ts` that returns `null` and answer 401 JSON. Never authorise with the service client.
   3. Body: Zod `{ orgId: z.string().uuid() }` → 400 on failure.
   4. `stripeConfig().configured` false → 503 `{ error: 'stripe_not_configured', missing }`.
   5. Load the org with the user client; `billing_mode !== 'stripe'` → 409 `{ error: 'billing_mode_not_stripe' }` (the super admin switches the mode in the Billing tab first — this is what makes the mirror trigger act); `status === 'cancelled'` → 409.
   6. `ensureCustomer(orgId)`, then `stripe.checkout.sessions.create({ mode: 'subscription', customer, client_reference_id: orgId, line_items: [{ price: priceId, quantity: 1 }], subscription_data: { metadata: { org_id: orgId } }, metadata: { org_id: orgId }, success_url: `${appUrl()}/admin/churches/${orgId}?billing=success`, cancel_url: `${appUrl()}/admin/churches/${orgId}?billing=cancelled`, allow_promotion_codes: false }, { idempotencyKey: `checkout:${orgId}:${Date.now()}` })`. Do not add `trial_period_days` — the 30-day trial is the app's `trial_ends_at`, not a Stripe trial. Respond 200 `{ url: session.url }`; the client navigates with `window.location.assign(url)`.
7. **`apps/web/app/api/billing/portal/route.ts`** — same origin/auth/Zod/config checks; `ensureCustomer(orgId)`; `stripe.billingPortal.sessions.create({ customer, return_url: `${appUrl()}/admin/churches/${orgId}` })` → 200 `{ url }`. If Stripe answers that no portal configuration exists (test mode needs one saved once in the Stripe Dashboard), return 502 `{ error: 'portal_not_configured' }` and show that text in the UI; the founder saves the default portal configuration in step 3.9.
8. **Billing tab wiring** — edit `src/features/orgs/BillingPanel.tsx` (server component reads, small client island for the buttons):
   - Read `stripeConfig()` on the server and pass only `{ configured, missing }` down. When not configured render an `Alert` (shadcn) "Stripe is not configured on this deployment. Set `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and `STRIPE_PRICE_ID` in Vercel (docs/TODO.md step 3.9) and redeploy." and keep both buttons disabled with a tooltip. The rest of the tab (billing_mode, trial, status actions from 2.2) keeps working.
   - When configured: "Start subscription" (enabled only when `billing_mode = 'stripe'`, otherwise tooltip "Set billing mode to Stripe first") posts to `/api/billing/checkout`; "Open customer portal" (enabled when a `billing_customers` row exists) posts to `/api/billing/portal`; both navigate to the returned `url`, and surface error JSON with `sonner` toasts using the messages above.
   - Subscription card: read `billing_subscriptions` for the org with the user client (super admin select policy) ordered by `updated_at desc`, show a `Badge` for `status` (green `active`/`trialing`, amber `past_due`/`unpaid`, red `canceled`/`incomplete_expired`, grey otherwise), `status_raw` when it differs, `current_period_end`, `cancel_at_period_end`, and "No Stripe subscription yet" when empty. Read the `?billing=success|cancelled` search param on the page and toast "Checkout completed — the badge updates when Stripe's webhook arrives (usually within seconds)" / "Checkout cancelled".
   - `/admin` churches list (2.2): the "subscription badge" column now reads the same `billing_subscriptions` data (latest row per org, via `src/features/orgs/billing-queries.ts` or the existing `@church/db` `queries/orgs.ts` — extend, do not duplicate). Add a one-line banner at the top of `/admin` when Stripe is not configured, linking to the ENV docs.
9. **Recent-events list (small):** at the bottom of the Billing tab show the last 10 `stripe_events` for that org's customer where available (type, `event_created` as a date, processed/error). If `stripe_events` has no `org_id` column (1.2 decides), show the global last 10 on `/admin` only for super admins and skip the per-org list — note which in HANDOFF.
10. **Env and docs.** `apps/web/.env.example`: the three `STRIPE_*` lines commented with "optional — leave unset until docs/TODO.md 3.9". `docs/ENV.md`: refine the three rows — who sets (founder, step 3.9), where (Vercel Production + Preview, local `.env.local` for `stripe listen`), format hints only (`sk_test_…` prefix for the test key, `whsec_…` for the webhook secret, `price_…` for the price), behaviour when absent (banner, webhook 503), and the local forwarding command `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/stripe/webhook`. Add a short `docs/BILLING.md` (chosen name) describing the flow: super admin sets `billing_mode = stripe` → Start subscription → Checkout → webhook → `billing_subscriptions` → trigger → `organizations.status`; what `manual` and `free` mean (no Stripe, super admin sets status by hand; `srv_housekeeping` flips `trial → past_due` after `trial_ends_at` for `stripe` and `manual`); that only `suspended` blocks writes; and the out-of-order / idempotency rules.
11. **Tests — `apps/web/src/lib/stripe/__tests__/webhook.test.ts`** (Vitest 4, no network): build a fake `deps.db` — an in-memory implementation of the four table operations the code uses (insert/select/update/upsert on `stripe_events`, `billing_customers`, `billing_subscriptions`, `organizations` read) behind the same small repository interface `sync.ts` and `webhook.ts` call (define `BillingRepo` in `sync.ts` with a Supabase-backed implementation and let tests pass a Map-backed one — this keeps the tests free of supabase-js mocking); a fake `stripe` with `subscriptions.retrieve` and `customers.create` stubs; and real signatures made with `new Stripe('sk_test_x').webhooks.generateTestHeaderString({ payload, secret })` so `constructEvent` runs for real. Cases: (a) no webhook secret → 503 and no `stripe_events` row; (b) bad signature → 400; (c) `customer.subscription.updated` → 200, `billing_subscriptions` row with mapped status and `event_created`, `stripe_events.processed_at` set; (d) same event id again → 200 with `duplicate: true` and `subscriptions.retrieve` not called again; (e) an event with a smaller `created` than the stored `event_created` → 200, row unchanged, `error = 'stale_event_ignored'`; (f) `subscriptions.retrieve` rejects → 500, `stripe_events.error` recorded, `processed_at` null, and a second delivery reprocesses; (g) unknown type → 200 `ignored: true`; (h) unresolvable org → 200 with `error = 'org_not_found'`; (i) table test for `mapStripeStatus` incl. an unexpected string → `unknown`; (j) `subscriptionIdFromInvoice` for both invoice shapes. Also `apps/web/src/lib/stripe/__tests__/sync.test.ts` for `subscriptionSnapshot` (item-level period fields, Unix → ISO) and `shouldApply`.
12. **Route smoke tests** (Vitest, call the route handlers directly with `new Request(...)`): webhook `POST` without env → 503; checkout `POST` with a wrong `origin` → 403; checkout unauthenticated → 401 (mock `getSuperAdminContext` to return null).

## Constraints
- Never put a Stripe key, webhook secret or price id into the repo, tests (use obvious placeholders), prompts, logs or the client bundle; `stripeConfig()` values never cross to client components — only booleans and variable names. `client.ts`, `sync.ts`, `webhook.ts` start with `import 'server-only'`.
- The service client is used only for the billing tables inside `sync.ts`/`webhook.ts`; authorisation of the checkout/portal routes uses the user client (`my_context()` / `super_admins` via RLS). Web never holds elevated keys client-side (standing order).
- The webhook must stay excluded from `proxy.ts`'s matcher and must not read cookies. Do not weaken CSP or security headers from 2.1; Stripe Checkout and the portal are full-page redirects, so no `frame-src`/`script-src` additions are needed. Do not embed Stripe.js.
- Do not edit `supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql` or add a migration: if a column you want is missing, adapt the code to the real schema and record it in HANDOFF.md "Deviations from plan" (a `9998_*` migration is a later, founder-approved step). Never run `supabase db push` or `db reset`.
- Do not build `/o/[orgSlug]/settings/billing` (step 3.1), Resend email (3.2), or the cron (3.6). Do not refactor the 2.2 pages beyond the Billing tab wiring and the `/admin` badge/banner.
- Pins: `stripe` 22.6.1, Next 16.3, Zod 4.5, Vitest 4, TypeScript ~5.9; `@types/react` on the 19.2 line. No model identifiers in commits or files.

## Verify
- `pnpm install` → clean; `git diff --stat pnpm-lock.yaml` shows only the `stripe` addition.
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → all tasks green, including the new `apps/web` Vitest files (at least 12 new tests passing).
- `pnpm --filter web build` → succeeds with no `STRIPE_*` variable set (mock Supabase values from `docs/ENV.md` are enough).
- `pnpm --filter web dev` with the mock env, then: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/stripe/webhook -d '{}'` → `503`; `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/billing/checkout -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"orgId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"}'` → `403` (no origin) and, with `-H 'origin: http://localhost:3000'`, `401` (not signed in); `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/api/stripe/webhook` → `405`.
- `grep -rn "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY" apps/web/app apps/web/src --include=*.tsx | grep -v server-only` → no client component reads it (manual review of the hits).
- Manual: with the local DB and dev seed from 1.5 signed in as the seeded super admin, `/admin/churches/<orgId>` Billing tab shows the not-configured banner, disabled buttons with tooltips, "No Stripe subscription yet", and the billing_mode / trial / status controls from 2.2 still save.

## Finish
- `HANDOFF.md`: State — tick the super admin billing item ("Stripe behind env — built, no keys yet"); feature table row "Super admin creates churches, settings, billing" Web UI → "built (Stripe wiring behind env; keys in step 3.9)"; founder to-dos — step 3.9 must create the product/price, the webhook endpoint `https://<VERCEL_URL>/api/stripe/webhook` with events `checkout.session.completed`, `customer.subscription.created|updated|deleted`, `invoice.payment_succeeded`, `invoice.payment_failed`, and save the default customer-portal configuration in test mode; "Deviations from plan" — `org_not_found` returns 200, `webhook.ts` file name, `docs/BILLING.md`, anything about the real `billing_customers` / `stripe_events` columns; version pins — `stripe` 22.6.1.
- Tick step 2.3 in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `feat(web): Stripe billing behind env — checkout, portal, webhook`; push `main`.
- If something in the plan proves impossible or wrong (for example the Stripe SDK's typed subscription no longer exposes a field named here), do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.
done_when: `apps/web/src/lib/stripe/client.ts`, `sync.ts`, `webhook.ts` exist, start with `import 'server-only'`, and `stripe` 22.6.1 is an exact dependency of `apps/web` (not in the pnpm catalog).

`POST /api/stripe/webhook` returns 503 when `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset, 400 on a bad signature, 200 with `duplicate: true` for an already-processed event id, 200 and no row change for an event older than the stored `event_created`, and 500 with `stripe_events.error` set when the handler throws; the route uses `runtime = 'nodejs'`, `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` and `await req.text()`.

`POST /api/billing/checkout` and `POST /api/billing/portal` answer 403 without a same-origin header, 401 when the caller is not a super admin, 503 with `missing: [...]` when Stripe env is absent, 409 when `billing_mode` is not `stripe`, and otherwise return `{ url }` from a Checkout Session (`mode: 'subscription'`, `customer=`, `line_items[0].price = STRIPE_PRICE_ID`, `metadata.org_id`) or a portal session.

The Billing tab of `/admin/churches/[orgId]` shows a 'Stripe is not configured' alert and disabled buttons when the env vars are absent, and the `/admin` list's subscription badge reads `billing_subscriptions`; `organizations.status` is never written by the Stripe code (only by the DB trigger).

`pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` is green with at least 12 new Vitest cases in `apps/web/src/lib/stripe/__tests__/` covering 503, bad signature, sync, idempotency, out-of-order, handler error, ignored type, org_not_found, status mapping and invoice subscription-id extraction; `pnpm --filter web build` succeeds with no `STRIPE_*` variable set.

`docs/ENV.md` rows for the three `STRIPE_*` variables say who sets them (founder, step 3.9), where, the format prefix, the behaviour when absent, and the `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/stripe/webhook` command; `docs/BILLING.md` describes the billing_mode semantics and the webhook rules.
HANDOFF.md records the deviations (`org_not_found` → 200, `webhook.ts`, `docs/BILLING.md`), the `stripe` pin, and the step 3.9 founder to-dos (product/price, webhook events, portal configuration).
steps.commit_message: feat(web): Stripe billing behind env — checkout, portal, webhook
reads: docs/PLAN.md §1 item 7, §7 (Stripe row, env vars), §8 (api/ routes), §13 answer 7

docs/DESIGN.md §1 item 7, §4 (organizations, billing_customers, billing_subscriptions, stripe_events, mirror_subscription_status), §6 (billing policy rows), §8 (Stripe rows), §9 (Billing tab), §13 rejected finding on subscription status enum

steps.notes: No Stripe keys exist at this point and none are needed: everything is verified by unit tests with real signature generation (`stripe.webhooks.generateTestHeaderString`) and a keyless dev server. Deviation made explicit: an event whose org cannot be resolved is acknowledged with 200 + `error='org_not_found'` instead of 500, because a permanent 500 would make Stripe disable the endpoint; stale events are also 200. `webhook.ts` and `docs/BILLING.md` are names chosen here (DESIGN §2 lists only `client.ts`/`sync.ts`). Recent Stripe API versions moved `current_period_*` onto subscription items and `invoice.subscription` under `invoice.parent.subscription_details` — the prompt handles both shapes. Checkout requires `billing_mode = 'stripe'` so the existing mirror trigger is the only writer of `organizations.status`; the 30-day trial stays an app concept (`trial_ends_at`), not a Stripe trial. `billing_customers` and `stripe_events` exact columns were fixed by G2 (1.2); the agent reads the migration. The customer portal needs a saved configuration in the Stripe Dashboard (step 3.9); until then the portal route returns 502 with a clear message. Step fits one session (≈ 10 new files).
